setup_repairs.issue: Local orchestration used unavailable btoa helper before changing the pod.
setup_repairs.resolution: Passed the public key directly to the authenticated gateway with structured quoting.

setup_repairs.issue: Initial tar extraction tried to preserve local UID/GID on the pod persistent filesystem: Cannot change ownership to uid 1000, gid 1000: Operation not permitted. The command stopped before launching the server.
setup_repairs.resolution: Extracted with tar --no-same-owner. Existing services and authentication configuration were unchanged.

setup_repairs.issue: Initial synthetic placement test mocked os.readlink globally; platform.platform then tried to read /test/python and failed.
setup_repairs.resolution: Isolated platform metadata in the test mock; 11 focused checks subsequently passed.

setup_repairs.issue: First result-copy command used a remote /. source, which SCP rejected as unexpected filename: .
setup_repairs.resolution: Copied the named stage1_gpu_live directory successfully. No live run was repeated.
